item.title: Bungalow 8-Step Automation Blueprint: Room-by-Room Layout With ROI Timeline
item.description:
Short answer: The Bungalow ($30,000 from Ray's Realty) supports 4 employees and fits 2 Mixing Stations for a fully automated 2-product line. Setup cost: ~$3,500 + property cost. Break-even in 7-10 in-game days. Below is the exact 8-step layout tested and verified by the community.

This guide is a room-by-room build order. Follow these steps in sequence to avoid common automation failures.

Step 1: Set Up The Loading Bay (Day 1, $0)

Before hiring anyone, clear the Bungalow's ground floor. The default furniture blocks employee pathing.

item.title: Manual vs Automation ROI Comparison: Which Setup Makes Money Faster
item.description:
Short answer: Full automation (Barn + 10 employees) earns roughly 5x more per day than manual play, but costs ~$45,000 upfront with a 5-8 day break-even. Partial automation (Bungalow + 3 employees) is the best value: ~$3,500 setup, 7-10 day break-even. Manual play breaks even instantly but caps at ~$2,000/day earnings.

This guide is a data comparison -- not a setup tutorial. Use the table below to decide whether automation is worth it for your current stage.

item.title: Schedule I Endgame Guide: What To Do After Full Automation
item.description:
Short answer: After full automation, endgame goals include: owning all 6 properties ($430,000 total), unlocking all 6 dealers ($15,500 total buy-in), maxing all 4 suppliers to Delivery status, hitting Kingpin V rank, and building a mega-factory using all properties. Each goal takes roughly 30-60 additional in-game hours.

This guide covers endgame activities after your automation is running. Verified against r/Schedule_I endgame discussions, Steam Community forum posts, and ScreenRant's endgame guide.

The Endgame Checklist

Priority Goal Cost Time Estimate Reward
1 Max all supplier relationships to Delivery ~$8,000 orders 15-20 in-game days Auto-supply to any location
2 Unlock all 6 dealers $15,500 cumulative 5-10 in-game days $8,000-15,000/day passive income
3 Buy the Docks Warehouse ($50,000) $50,000 3-5 days saving 60-80 bags/day production
4 Reach Kingpin V rank N/A (revenue-based) ~30 in-game days Max rank benefits
5 Build a mega-factory $250,000+ 50-100 in-game days Highest possible production
6 Own all 6 properties $430,000 total 60-120 in-game days Complete empire
7 Complete all customer unlocks N/A Varies All customers available
8 Try Beta mode Free N/A New content preview

Goal 1: Max All Supplier Relationships

This is the highest-impact endgame goal. Once all 4 suppliers reach Delivery status, your supply chain becomes fully passive.
